command.description: Check the last turn now for something you may have skipped or misunderstood
card.title: 🔍 {kind}
card.free.label: Answer in your own words
kind.skipped: A point you moved on from
kind.premise: A premise you did not state
kind.misread: A premise you may have taken differently
log.title: Question card log
log.question: Question
check.off: The question card is off here. Say "turn the question card back on" to turn it on.
check.pending: A question is already waiting above the prompt.
check.no_turn: There is no turn to check yet.
check.asked: A question is up above the prompt.
check.none: Found nothing worth asking about in the last turn.
check.failed: The check could not run this time. Try again later.
check.broken: The question card is off because its settings file cannot be read: {path}. Fix it or delete it (ask Claude to), and the card comes back.
notice.welcome: Question card is on: after some turns it may ask one question above the prompt. /criteria-check asks now; say "turn off the question card" to stop it.
notice.config_broken: The question card is off: {path} cannot be read. Ask Claude to fix or delete it.
notice.judge_failed: The question card could not reach its judge model (Sonnet) twice in a row, so it may stay quiet. Check that this session can use Sonnet; /criteria-check shows if it still fails.
